items.docs: __Kona Site Defender__, __App & API Protector with the Advanced Security module__ Update what action to take when the API request constraint triggers. This operation modifies an individual API constraint action. To use this operation, run [List all API request constraints and actions](https://techdocs.akamai.com/application-security/reference/get-api-request-constraints) and pick an API from the response list. Use `alert` to record the trigger of the event, `deny` to block the request, or `none`
